title: Rewinding the word tape
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $y$ and $w$ be Boolean words, let $P$ be an input-head position among the $|y|+2$ positions, and let $b$ be a Boolean vector with one coordinate for each selector bit of $M$. Let $	au_0,	au_2: br	o	ext{Option}(	ext{Bool})$ be tape contents and let $z_0,z_2\\in\bbr$. For every natural number $j\le |w|$, after $j+1$ steps from the configuration in state $\mathrm{rewC}$ with auxiliary tapes containing $\tau_0$, the word $w$ stored from cell zero, and $\tau_2$, and head positions $z_0,j-1,z_2$, the machine is in state $\mathrm{rewO}$ with the same tape contents, input-head position $P$, first and third auxiliary head positions $z_0$ and $z_2-1$, and middle auxiliary head position $0$; the output remains empty.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine M over Boolean symbols
An input-head position P among the |y|+2 positions
A Boolean vector b with one coordinate for each selector bit of M
Integer-indexed tape contents τ₀ and τ₂
Integer head positions z₀ and z₂
A natural number j satisfying j ≤ |w|
